title: Ron B Probable NDE 6208
content: I was crushed under an elevator at work. I felt my life leave my body and then I was in darkness. It was so dark I could feel it. I was floating and the temperature was pleasant. I heard and saw my wife crying for me and telling me to fight. She said, 'Fight! You're a fighter!' A man in a white robe that I saw by her, who I thought was a doctor, said, 'He can't hear a word you say.' I was angry when I heard him say that. I found out later that he was a male nurse. When I got angry, I was taken away from seeing my wife to that dark place again. I could hear my thoughts; my mouth didn't need to talk. I began to see what looked like smoke and reddish orange color. I was taken closer until I could see it was fire in the form of a lake! I was terrified. Then I came back in my body and I was on life support and the doctor said let's see if he can breathe on his own. I was choked from the long tube that was being removed and I threw up, I was terrified because I thought I was going to hell. I was supposed to be brain dead and paralyzed from the neck down due to my number 1 and 2 vertebr' being crushed. He told my wife I would never walk again and I would have to go to a home to be cared for because I was a vegetable. Praise GOD; I walked out of the hospital 6 days later! I was in a coma for 2 days and then I began getting better.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'my life leave my body' and was 'floating'; temperature was pleasant.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'man in a white robe' near his wife, later identified as a male nurse (initially thought to be a doctor).

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness ('so dark I could feel it'), 'smoke and reddish orange color,' and 'fire in the form of a lake.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Crushed under an elevator at work.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed wife crying and urging him to fight; later saw 'a lake' of fire; returned while on life support as breathing tube removed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/darkness with observation of wife, then back to dark place, then approach to smoke/red-orange and lake of fire, then return to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the dark place after becoming angry.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported hearing/seeing his wife and a robed man speaking near her; later learned the robed man was a male nurse.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Wife: 'Fight! You're a fighter!' Robed man: 'He can't hear a word you say.'
